top_reviews.title: Wildly exceed expectations
top_reviews.text: I've been running in Nike shoes for more than 30 years. I normally get about 400-450 miles per pair of Nike running shoes (my last favorite running shoe was the Nike Air Max). These Zoom Pegasus Turbo 2 shoes are remarkable; the last pair survived for more than EIGHT HUNDRED MILES! (I average about 60 miles of running on roads per month.) And they are so lightweight, they're a joy to run in. I couldn't believe the mileage -- 800+ miles! I have purchased two more pairs because I'm worried Nike will stop making this wonderful shoe.

top_reviews.title: Seemed well made and comfortable but did not fit and I had to return them.
top_reviews.text: Seemed decent and had comfortable cushion but the boots did not fit my foot at all and I had to return them. I ended up getting a vintage pair of redwing engineers instead that fit me. I wish they still made the Chippewas and the redwing engineers but they discontinued them for whatever reason. I recommend trying to find the made in the USA vintage engineers in good condition that fit your foot.

top_reviews.title: Great pair of boots
top_reviews.text: Real quality workmanship. These boots should last forever
